#### Hessian

The **Hessian matrix** of the log-likelihood function
is the matrix of its second derivatives
with respect to the parameters:

{{< include sds/_subfiles/intro-MLEs/_eq_def_hess.qmd >}}

:::

::: notes
The Hessian is named after the mathematician
[Otto Hesse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otto_Hesse).
:::
